entries.label: ROM header, boot-loader area and the first bytes of the boot code image
evidence: file table record 0: virtual 0x0-0x1060, ROM 0x0-0x1060, stored
header word 0x08 = 0x80000400; the IPL copies ROM 0x1000 onward to RAM 0x80000400

entries.label: boot code
evidence: file table record 1: virtual 0x1060-0x7950, ROM 0x1060-0x7950, stored
part of the boot image ROM 0x1000-0x7950 loaded at 0x80000400, entry 0x80000400
0x80000418: loop storing zero through 0x80006d50 in 8-byte steps until a counter initialised to 0x4a20 reaches zero
0x8000042c: jr to 0x80000498 with sp set to 0x80007740 in the delay slot

entries.label: file table
evidence: file table record 2: virtual 0x7950-0xd8c0, ROM 0x7950-0xd8c0, stored
the table of 16-byte file records starts at the first byte of this file (ROM 0x7950) and lies inside it

entries.label: instrument bank file
evidence: file table record 3: virtual 0xd8c0-0x39680, ROM 0xd8c0-0x39680, stored
38 entries (38 with data) at code file +0xffe60 (RAM 0x80111540) whose offset and size fields address this file; the last range ends 0x20 before its end
the audio set-up passes the table and the ROM address 0xd8c0 of this file together (code at 0x800b8f6c)
table read by code at 0x800b8f20
every entry starts with offsets that all lie inside the entry

entries.label: sequence file
evidence: file table record 4: virtual 0x39680-0x89100, ROM 0x39680-0x89100, stored
110 entries (109 with data) at code file +0x100290 (RAM 0x80111970) whose offset and size fields address this file; the last range ends 0x0 before its end
the audio set-up passes the table and the ROM address 0x39680 of this file together (code at 0x800b8f58)
table read by code at 0x800b8f1c
a map at code file +0x1000d0 holds one list of bank numbers per entry (110 lists, every number below the bank count)

entries.label: sample data file
evidence: file table record 5: virtual 0x89100-0x4da490, ROM 0x89100-0x4da490, stored
7 entries (6 with data) at code file +0x100980 (RAM 0x80112060) whose offset and size fields address this file; the last range ends 0x0 before its end
the audio set-up passes the table and the ROM address 0x89100 of this file together (code at 0x800b8f80)
table read by code at 0x800b8f24, 0x800d7b20
the remaining audio table: its ranges are not banks and no per-entry bank map exists

entries.label: per-frame joint rotation data read one frame per transfer
evidence: file table record 6: virtual 0x4da490-0x7400c0, ROM 0x4da490-0x7400c0, stored

0x8008BB20-0x8008BB78: the transfer size is (limb count * 3 * 2) + 2 bytes, and the ROM address is the file start 0x4DA490 + (the low 24 bits of a word of a record) + frame * that size, passed to dma_request_send (0x80000E68)
so the file is a sequence of frames of 6n+2 bytes (n limbs of three 16-bit rotations plus two bytes), fetched one frame at a time
code sites: 0x8008bb58
